summary: Reviewed 3 files (subagents.py, nodes/__init__.py, config.py). 0 Critical, 0 High findings. 1 Low (no path containment guard on workspace_root / persona_file), 1 Medium pre-existing (inherit_env=True, documented/deferred, not WP-013 scope). Security sign-off: PASS.

comments.note: Low — A01 (Broken Access Control / Path Traversal): subagents.py:79: `full_path = workspace_root / persona_file` constructs a path without a resolve()-based containment guard. persona_file is a static constant today (no exploit), but pathlib silently resolves `../..` sequences — if STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES ever accepts user-configurable or manifest-derived paths, traversal outside workspace_root becomes possible. Remediation: add `if not full_path.resolve().is_relative_to(workspace_root.resolve()): raise ValueError(...)` immediately after constructing full_path.

Medium (pre-existing, documented, not WP-013 scope) — A05 (Security Misconfiguration): nodes/__init__.py:365: `LocalShellBackend(inherit_env=True)` forwards all host environment variables (including ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, and other secrets) to agent subprocesses. Documented inline (SECURITY DECISION 2026-03-30) and tracked in docs/agents/deferred-topics.md. Not introduced by WP-013; noted for completeness.

Info — Trust boundary: persona file content is read verbatim and passed as system_prompt to create_deep_agent() without content validation. This is intentional and correct — persona files are developer-authored trusted build artifacts, not runtime user input. The trust model is well-defined and acceptable for a local developer tool.

summary: Reviewed orchestrator/src/utils/subagents.py (new), src/nodes/__init__.py, src/config.py, and tests/test_nodes.py. No blocking issues found. Architecture is sound: config-driven subagent wiring via STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES, clean cache design appropriate for a single-run CLI, correct falsy-list-to-None coercion, and consistent deferred-import pattern.

Applied three Fix-Forward (non-behavioral) improvements: (1) Added path containment guard in subagents.py per Security Auditor Low recommendation — raises ValueError if full_path resolves outside workspace_root; (2) Renamed local variable _subagents → stage_subagents in nodes/__init__.py for clarity (underscore prefix was confusing for a non-private local); (3) Removed unused _patch_subagents helper method from TestSubagentWiring (dead code — all tests inlined the patch directly).
All 7 TestSubagentWiring tests pass after Fix-Forward edits.

comments.note: subagents.py: Added path containment guard after full_path construction — `if not full_path.resolve().is_relative_to(workspace_root.resolve()): raise ValueError(...)`. Addresses Security Auditor Low finding. Guard fires before the exists() check so traversal attempts are rejected before any I/O. Non-behavioral for current static STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES values.

nodes/__init__.py: Renamed local variable `_subagents` → `stage_subagents`. Underscore prefix is Python convention for private/protected names; using it for an ordinary local variable that doesn't shadow anything at module scope was misleading. The name `stage_subagents` maps cleanly to what the value represents.

tests/test_nodes.py: Removed unused `_patch_subagents(self, stage, subagents)` helper method from TestSubagentWiring. The method was defined but never called — all three test methods inlined `patch('src.utils.subagents.load_subagents', ...)` directly. Dead code removed.

No dedicated test_subagents.py exists for load_subagents unit behavior (FileNotFoundError on missing file, cache clear semantics, unknown stage → []). QA verified these edge cases via interactive terminal execution (confirmed in session terminal log), but they are not captured as formal pytest tests. Recommend adding a test_subagents.py unit file to lock in these edge-case contracts.

[documentation-forward] STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES in config.py is a manually maintained constant (not manifest-derived), unlike PERSONA_FILES and AGENT_ROLES. Developer's own comment flags this. Document in orchestrator manifest (constraints.md or data-flows.md) that STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES is a static config map separate from the workflow manifest, and note the future improvement path: add a 'subagents' key to workflow-manifest.json roles so this auto-derives from the manifest.
